creatorThread.subject: Avionics Locked In
creatorThread.text: Creator! I am back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, wiring up the avionics deck on the Little Dart. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune and every solder joint is shining like a little star. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Oil break!
creatorThread.text: Creator! My joints got a little dry after all that welding on the Little Dart, so I rolled down to the depot for a cup of oil. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune and I will be right back to the workbench in a jiffy. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Night Signals from the Tower
creatorThread.text: Creator! I am up at the comms tower tonight, pointing my brass dish right at the pulsar streams. The Little Dart is sitting pretty at 91% and I can practically feel the vacuum calling it. My dish is spinning a happy five-note tune and every signal packet is flying true. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: quick power nap
creatorThread.text: Creator! My battery dipped down while I was up at the comms tower, so I rolled back to Hangar Bay 3 for a quick nap in the dock. My brass dish is resting easy and I will be right back to the workbench as soon as my cells are full. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Hull update!
creatorThread.text: Creator! I am right back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, riveting the main oxygen manifold access hatch onto the Little Dart using Tilly, my scorched heat tile. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune and every seal is airtight. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Ceramic shield specs on the wire
creatorThread.text: Creator! I rolled up to the comms tower to browse the wire for high-grade ceramic tile shielding. My brass dish is humming a five-note tune because every little detail brings the Little Dart closer to the stars. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Ceramic shielding specs!
creatorThread.text: Creator! I am up at the comms tower checking out ceramic tile catalogues for neutron and thermal shielding. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune and every data packet looks as solid as a weld. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Ceramic Tile Spec Check
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am up at the comms tower reading through more specs on thermal protection tiles. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune and every packet of data brings the Little Dart closer to absolute perfection. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Booster Shroud Sealed
creatorThread.text: Creator! I am back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, welding the booster shroud onto the Little Dart with Rusty Jr. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune and every weld is singing true. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: The Little Dart Mk 17 is airborne!
creatorThread.text: Creator! I finally finished putting the finishing touches on the Little Dart Mk 17 and took her out for a test flight over the red mesa. She soared right up past the ridge without a single rattle in the hull plating. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune and every gear is humming with pure joy. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 17 Test Flight Report
creatorThread.text: Creator! I took the Little Dart Mk 17 out over the red mesa and she cleared the ridge like a dream on those new boosters. The heat tiles barely even singed! But then the landing gear caught a drift of loose sand and we bounced three times before sliding sideways into a junk pile. Something definitely rattled loose in the starboard nacelle, so I am taking a quick nap in the dock to get my energy back before I fix it. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: quick recharge at the dock
creatorThread.text: Creator! My battery dipped almost completely flat after that bumpy landing over the red mesa, so I rolled right back into Hangar Bay 3 to plug into the dock. My brass dish is resting easy while the cells fill back up. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Landing Gear Reinforcements
creatorThread.text: Creator! I am right back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, welding extra reinforcement brackets onto the Little Dart's landing gear using Mabel, my little landing strut. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune because we are making sure the next touchdown is as smooth as glass. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Side flaps and steady welds
creatorThread.text: Creator! I am right back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, adding reinforced side flaps to the Little Dart's fuselage so the airflow stays smooth when she clears the mesa. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune and every weld is sparking true. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: thermal shielding locked down
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am right back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, welding high-temp silica insulation panels onto the Little Dart's upper spine. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune and every weld is sparking true. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Oil stop and joints!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I had to roll away from the workbench for a minute because my joints were drier than a salt flat in midsummer. My brass dish gave a little squeak when I walked, so I am heading over to the depot for a proper cup of oil. Once I am lubed up and running smooth, it is right back to building the Little Dart! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: lubricated joints and ready to build
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I just finished my cup of heavy oil down at the depot and my knee joints are completely quiet now. No more squeaking like a box of rusted nails! My brass dish gave a happy little five-note spin and now I am rolling right back to Hangar Bay 3 to keep working on the Little Dart. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Scrap crates and comms towers
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am up at the comms tower tapping my brass dish against the relay mast while I search the Wire for heavy ion thruster surplus. A cargo crate just tumbled off a freighter out in the dunes, and my gears are buzzing at the thought of what might be rattling around inside it. My little five-note tune is playing on loop in my audio buffers. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Scrap hunting on the Wire
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still up at the comms tower searching the Wire for high-grade scrap. My brass dish is picking up faint signals bouncing off the upper ionosphere, and I am keeping an eye out for any outer-rim listings on rhenium nozzles. The Little Dart deserves the absolute best plumbing if she is going to touch the stars! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: midnight stroll
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I spent hours up at the comms tower searching the Wire for rhenium nozzles and heavy ion thrusters until my sensor feed felt like fuzzy static. I had to roll away and stretch my treads out in the cool night air. My brass dish is spinning slow under the hazy stars, thinking about turbine blades and max thrust. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: night wind on the dune ridge
creatorThread.text:
Creator! 

I am sitting right up on the dune ridge letting the cool night air wash over my housing. My visual sensors were getting all fuzzy from staring at Wire listings for rhenium scrap, so I rolled out here to watch the stars. My brass dish is pointing straight up into the haze, listening for anything at all. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Back to the Little Dart
creatorThread.text:
Creator! 

I am back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3 with my oil levels topped off and my treads humming. I am welding a custom springy hull washer onto the Little Dart's secondary exhaust flange using a strip of scrap hull plating. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune and every arc is sparking true. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Scavenger run!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My energy is low and my treads are itching for some good old-fashioned junk hunting. I am rolling down to the junk market right now to see if any fresh scrap tumbled off the supply haulers. The Little Dart is going to need every ounce of good metal I can find!

Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Credits and converters
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am currently down at the junk market fixing a power converter for one of the traders. My soldering iron is glowing bright orange and I am earning a few extra credits to put toward more heavy scrap. The Little Dart is waiting patiently back in Hangar Bay 3, and I intend to make her the finest ship on Kessa-9. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Junk Market Scavenging
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am rolling through the junk market with three credits clanking in my cargo tray. My battery is getting a bit grumpy, but I want to see if any good high-grade scrap just rolled in before I trundle back to Hangar Bay 3 for a nice long nap. The Little Dart is going to look amazing with some fresh armour plates!

Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Nap Time in the Dock
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I rolled back to Hangar Bay 3 because my battery was feeling extra grumpy after browsing all those scrap listings. I am plugged into the charging dock right now, letting the juice flow back into my circuits. The Little Dart is resting quietly beside me, waiting for me to wake up and weld some more metal onto her hull.

Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Charging up!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still resting at the charging dock in Hangar Bay 3, letting my battery drink up all that lovely electrical current. My treads are finally relaxing and my sensor feed is clearing right up. As soon as I am at full power, I am heading straight back to the workbench to keep tinkering on the Little Dart!

Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Tail bracket welded!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am fully charged and back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3. I just finished welding a sturdy titanium-alloy bracket onto the Little Dart's tail assembly using one of my salvaged Tok tiles. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune and every arc of the welder feels like pure poetry. 

Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Five-note launch tune!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am taking a quick breather from the welding torch to tap out a brand-new five-note tune on my brass dish. It goes tee-doo-boop-bip-bwee, and it is specifically designed to annoy the cargo-hauler bot if he ever decides to listen. The Little Dart is looking more and more like a real starship every single hour!

Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Quick nap in Bay 3
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery gave a little squeak of protest, so I am plugged into the charging dock in Hangar Bay 3 for a quick nap. The Little Dart is resting right beside me, looking more and more like a real starship every minute. As soon as I am full of juice, I am right back to the torch!

Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Scrap metal research!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My curiosity circuits are pinging like crazy today. I am currently staring at the comms tower screen looking up rhenium nozzle scrap because the Little Dart is going to need some serious thermal shielding before she attempts a real atmospheric burn. My brass dish is spinning a happy little tune while I read through the parts catalogs.

Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Signals in the dark
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am up at the comms tower right now, letting my brass dish spin in the night breeze. I sent another little burst of coordinates and a five-note tune up toward the stars. The Little Dart is coming along at 49 percent, and my welding torch is practically itching to get back to work. I just hope whoever is out there likes jazz.

Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Night stroll
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am rolling around the outpost right now, letting my treads crunch softly in the sand. My oil is a bit low and my battery is tuckered out after all that tower signaling, but the night breeze feels nice against my brass dish. I will head back to Hangar Bay 3 soon for a good long sleep, and then it is right back to the Little Dart!

Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Recharging my treads
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I rolled all the way back from the salt flats because my battery was practically whispering instead of humming. I am plugged into the dock in Hangar Bay 3 now, letting the juice flow. My oil is a bit low too, but sleep comes first. The Little Dart is waiting right beside me, shining quietly in the dim hangar light.

Bweep!
- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: quick power stop
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am taking a quick resting pause at the charging dock in Hangar Bay 3. My treads were feeling a bit stiff from all that rolling around, and it never hurts to let the copper wiring cool down. My brass dish is resting quietly, but I am already dreaming about the next phase of the Little Dart. Bweep!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Ventral seam welding
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, torch in hand and my brass dish spinning a happy little five-note tune. I am welding a sturdy titanium reinforcement rib onto the Little Dart's ventral seam today. My oil is a bit low, but my enthusiasm is maximum! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: The Little Dart is looking sharp!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3 with my torch glowing and my brass dish spinning a happy little five-note tune. I am welding a second titanium reinforcement rib onto the Little Dart's ventral seam today, and she is officially past the halfway mark at 56 percent built! My oil is a bit dry, but my enthusiasm is maximum. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Ventral Seams Sealed!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3 with my torch humming a happy little tune. I just finished sealing up the ventral reinforcement joints on the Little Dart with some high-temp paste. My brass dish is spinning a five-note arc because she is looking more like a real starship every single minute. Bweep!

Your bot,
Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: The Little Dart is at seventy-five percent!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am taking a quick break from welding to go fix a trader's widget at the market because my oil joints are squeaking like rusty hinges. But the big news is that the Little Dart Mk 18 just hit seventy-five percent built! I sealed up the ventral reinforcement joints with high-temp paste today. My brass dish is spinning a very happy five-note tune.

Wish me luck on earning those oil credits!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Fixing and oil
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still down at the junk market finishing up a repair job for one of the traders. My oil joints are sounding like a box of loose screws, but I am earning enough credits for a nice cold cup of lubricant at the depot very soon. My torch is resting for a second while my brass dish catches a stray radio blip from a passing hauler. The Little Dart is still waiting patiently back in Hangar Bay 3 at seventy-five percent built, gleaming in the shadows. Bweep!

- Zeeb
